correctness.rationale: Exhaustive classification of all missing forward links into internal and apex-targeting cases, exact trophic-level shifts and edge-distance residuals, integer quadratic minimization with no half-integer ties, and strict bound excluding all apex links. value.rationale: For a natural extreme omnivory case—a food chain with basal-to-apex predation—the complete extra-link design has an exact interior solution, position-degenerate at fixed span, with a nonobvious optimal skipped span close to 2/5 of total length. A second long-range link strictly improves the accepted structural coherence score for all n, asymptotically reducing squared incoherence by one fifth. It is an exact, useful benchmark for structural ecology models, not a claim of empirical stability or conservation impact.
